title: Dyreparken
description: Client-side modpack for better performance and a better vanilla experience.
body:
This is a modpack i created for my friends with less powerful PCs to use on our server. The modpack includes performance mods and other must have mods. Every mod is client-side. 

The modpack is currently only for 1.19.3 and uses Fabric - 0.14.12.

It has all the features from Optifine but uses performance mods like Sodium, Iris Shaders, Indium and Starlight.

It also has some mods i just find useful like: BetterF3, Appleskin, JourneyMap, Jade, Inventory HUD+ and Mouse Tweaks.
